info.title: TD SYNNEX Partner API
info.description:
These APIs provide real-time access to core TD SYNNEX partner workflows, including authentication, order and quote status lookup, purchase order submission and status, invoice queries, price and availability checks, and freight quote calculation.

Authenticate with OAuth2 first, then use the endpoints to integrate order and pricing operations into your applications.

post.description:
Obtain an OAuth2 access token using client credentials.

Use this token in the `Authorization` header for all subsequent API requests.

**Token Lifetime:** 7200 seconds (2 hours)

get.description:
Look up quote status and detail by CPO ID.

Use this endpoint for quote lookups. For sales-order or PO lookups, use Get order status.

OAuth 2.0 bearer token required. Most errors return HTTP 200 with `errorMessage` on a single array element.

200.description: Successful response with quote status array, or in-body error on an array element.

value.errorMessage: Please check the oauth2.0 access token!
Quote is not found! Please check SHOW_IN_EC profile.

get.description:
Look up order status by identifier and optional `inputType`.

- `SO` (default) — pass the sales order number as `orderNo`.
- `PO-v2` — pass the partner PO number as `orderNo`; may return multiple array elements.
  Includes `estimatedDeliveryDate`, `shipDate`, and `invoiceDate` on sub-lines.

For quote lookups by CPO ID, use `GET /api/v1/webservice/json/GetQuote/{cpoId}`.

OAuth 2.0 bearer token required. Most errors return HTTP 200 with `errorMessage` on a single array element.

parameters.name: orderNo
parameters.description:
Lookup key whose meaning depends on `inputType`:
sales order number for `SO`, partner PO number for `PO-v2`.

parameters.name: inputType
parameters.description:
Lookup mode. Defaults to `SO` when omitted.
Use `PO-v2` for partner PO number lookups (`estimatedDeliveryDate`, `shipDate`, and `invoiceDate` on sub-lines).
For quotes, use GetQuote instead.

200.description: Successful response with order status array, or in-body error on an array element.

value.errorMessage: Please check the oauth2.0 access token!

post.description:
Query real-time price and inventory by TD SYNNEX SKU or manufacturer part number.

Submit up to 100 items in `skuList`. Business errors may return HTTP `200` with `errorMessage`/`errorDetail` in the body.
With OAuth 2.0, omit `customerNo`/`userName`/`password` — customer is taken from the access token.

post.description:
Query inventory quantities without pricing.

Request shape matches GetPriceAvailability. Version 2.8 has no availability-specific fields (no MSRP). Business errors may return HTTP `200` with `errorMessage`/`errorDetail` in the body.
With OAuth 2.0, omit `customerNo`/`userName`/`password` — customer is taken from the access token.

post.description:
Submit a purchase order in JSON format.

Validation errors use `OrderResponse.ErrorMessage`/`ErrorDetail`. Auth and downstream failures use top-level `errorMessage`/`errorDetail`.
With OAuth 2.0, omit `Credential` and `CustomerNumber` when the token supplies the customer.

List purchase orders entered within a date range (maximum 14 days).

Empty results return `TotalCount: 0` with `PurchaseOrder: null`.
Validation errors use `PurchaseOrderList.ErrorMessage`; service errors use `BizError`.

po_list_request.summary: Query PO list by date range (version 2.1)

200.description: Successful response with PO list data or service-level error information.

po_list_error_response.summary: Service returns PO list error payload

PurchaseOrderList.ErrorDetail: Please check query criteria to ensure the date range is less than 14 days.
EndDate should be large than StartDate.

post.description:
Look up processing and shipment status for a purchase order (PO) by PO number.

PO not found returns HTTP 200 with `OrderStatusResponse.Code` = `notFound` (versions 2.1+). Validation and auth errors use `BizError` with `OrderStatusResponse` null.
`GetAssetTag=Y` populates `AssetNo` from version 2.8. See Markdown for 2.6 vs 2.7+ differences.

po_status_request.summary: Query PO status by PO number (version 2.6)

po_status_asset_tag_request.summary: Query PO status with asset tags (version 2.8+)

200.description: Successful response with PO status data or service-level error information.

po_status_asset_tag_response.summary: PO status with asset tags (version 2.8, GetAssetTag=Y)

post.description:
List invoice order summaries in a date range.

Use GetInvoice for full invoice documents. Empty results return `TotalCount: 0` with `InvoiceOrder: []`.
No 14-day date-range limit (unlike GetPOList). Validation errors use `errorMessage`/`errorDetail`; service errors use `BizError`.

200.description: Successful response with invoice list report or service-level error information.

post.description:
Retrieve invoice detail by customer PO number or TD SYNNEX sales order number.

When both `PONumber` and `OrderNumber` are sent, `PONumber` is used. Errors return HTTP `200` with `InvoiceResponse.ErrorCode`/`ErrorReason`.
With OAuth 2.0, omit `Credential` and `CustomerNumber` — the service fills them from the access token.

200.description: Successful response with invoice details or invoice-specific errors.

post.description:
Estimate freight charges and available ship methods for one or more SKUs.

Most validation and business errors return HTTP 200 with `FreightQuoteResponse.ErrorMessage` or `BizError`.
A missing request body returns HTTP 400 with `Bad Request` in `FreightQuoteResponse`.

bearerAuth.description:
OAuth2 Client Credentials authentication.

When using a valid bearer token, request-body credential fields (`customerNo`, `CustomerNumber`, `userName`, `password`, and `Credential`) are optional; the customer account is resolved from the token.

1. Obtain access token from: https://sso.us.tdsynnex.com/oauth2/v1/token
2. Include in Authorization header as: Bearer {access_token}
3. Token expires in 7200 seconds (2 hours)

Example: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...

LegacyCredential.description: Partner credential block for direct (non-OAuth2) authentication. Optional when using OAuth2 bearer token; customer identity is taken from the access token instead.

UserID.description: Partner user ID. Required in this block when not using OAuth2.

Password.description: Partner password. Required in this block when not using OAuth2.

synnexSKU.description: TD SYNNEX SKU number. Provide at least one of `synnexSKU`, `mfgPN`, or `customerPartNo`.

mfgPN.description: Manufacturer part number. Provide at least one of `synnexSKU`, `mfgPN`, or `customerPartNo`. One `mfgPN` may expand to multiple SKUs; duplicate `mfgPN` values in one request are deduplicated.

lineNumber.description: Line number used to match request and response items. Defaults to `100 + index + 1` when omitted or zero.

priceType.description: Optional pricing type (`REGULAR`, `EDUCATION`, `PROMOTION`, `HEALTHCARE`, `FEDERALGOVERNMENT`, `STATEGOVERNMENT`). When omitted on an Active SKU, defaults to `PROMOTION`. Unrecognized values are coerced to `PROMOTION`.

unitOfMeasure.description: Optional unit of measure. Defaults to `EA` when omitted. When combined with `customerPartNo`, warehouse `qty` and line `totalQuantity` are divided by the UOM factor; invalid UOM returns `InvalidMfgPartNumber`.

ReservedInventoryFlag.description: Reserved-inventory flag (`Y`/`N` or `TRUE`/`FALSE`). Effective when request `version` is `2.4`.

requestWarehouse.description: Comma-separated warehouse numbers (e.g. `3,8`). Effective when request `version` is `2.3`.

onOrderQuantity.description: On-order quantity for the warehouse. Returned when request `version` is `2.1`.

estimatedArrivalDate.description: ETA for on-order quantity (`yyyyMMdd`). Returned when request `version` is `2.1`.

status.description: Product status such as `Active`, `Inactive`, `Discontinued`, `Not found`, `Not authorized`, `Not authorized to buy`, or `Unknown:{char}`.

GlobalProductStatusCode.description: For Active priced SKUs, may be `Active-'{skuStatus}'`; unauthorized statuses may be `Not authorized-'{skuStatus}'` or `Not authorized to buy-'{skuStatus}'`; `null` when `status` is `Not found`.

EURequired.description: End-user required flag (`Y`/`N`). Returned when request `version` is `2.6` or `2.8`.

msrp.description: Suggested retail price. Returned when request `version` is `2.8`.

weight.description: Part weight. Returned when request `version` is `2.8`.
